scripts.dev: bunx concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "cd apps/backend && bun run dev" "cd apps/web && bun run dev"
scripts.type-check: cd apps/backend && bunx tsc --noEmit && cd ../web && bunx tsc --noEmit
scripts.ci: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run type-check
scripts.test: cd apps/backend && bun test && cd ../web && bun test
scripts.extensions:list: bun -e 'import { CONNECTORS } from "@packages/extension"; for (const c of CONNECTORS) console.log(c.id, c.lang, c.hasCloudflare ? "CF" : "");'
